user.title: Rain Radar Alarm
user.description:
Rain forecasts for the next two hours from Bureau of Meteorology radar, worked out here in Home Assistant. Your Home Assistant downloads radar images directly from BoM's public FTP service; nothing goes through anyone else's server.

BoM's terms allow this data for personal or in-house use only: it may not be passed on to other people or used commercially.

data.accept_terms: I'll use BoM radar data for personal, non-commercial use only

data_description.persons: Leave empty to track everyone, including people added later. People are followed by their phone's location.
data_description.soon_minutes: The Rain soon sensor turns on when rain is this close.
data_description.radar_range: Larger images see rain coming from further away, at half the detail.
data_description.fallback: A free model forecast (not radar) for places more than about 120 km from a BoM radar. Free for non-commercial use.
data_description.alert_probability: How much of the area around a location must be forecast to have rain before it counts. Lower warns earlier with more false alarms.
data_description.rain_threshold: Rain lighter than this is ignored. 0.2 mm/h is the lightest rain BoM radar shows.

error.terms_required: Please confirm the BoM data terms to continue.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Rain Radar Alarm is already set up. Use Configure to change it.
